import shutil,sys,unittest
from unittest import mock
from tests import test_codex_worker_lane as tests
original_host=tests.FakeHost
class NativeHost(original_host):
    def __init__(self,testcase):
        super().__init__(testcase)
        self.base_args[1]=shutil.which("codex")
        if not self.base_args[1]:
            raise RuntimeError("native Codex unavailable")
        # Native profile dependencies from the existing native config test, unchanged.
        self.config["mcp_servers"].update({
            "serena":{"command":f"{self.eco}/bin/serena"},
            "codebase-memory":{"command":"/bin/false"},
        })
        self.write_config(self.config)
with mock.patch.object(tests,"FakeHost",NativeHost):
    cases=[
        tests.RoleStepTests("test_b_apply_creates_the_roles_read_back_and_rollback_removes_them"),
        tests.ApplyFlowTests("test_owned_profile_migration_journals_and_restores_bytes_and_mode"),
    ]
    result=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=1).run(unittest.TestSuite(cases))
sys.exit(0 if result.wasSuccessful() else 1)
